# Caught Games

> B2B studio that designs, builds and licenses crash, instant-win and slot games to licensed online casino operators, with play-money demos of every game on this site.

Caught Games makes casino games with published math. Catalogue: crash games PEEK! (with the neutral skin Vault Heist), SKYLINE, FREEZE and PASS IT; instant games SNEAK, GOOSE 63 and WOBBLE; mines games SONAR and SONAR 3D, where every tile shows how many mines touch it; slots LAST REEL and SQUISH JAR. Default RTP is 97% for the crash and step games (configurable per market, typically 95 to 99%), LAST REEL runs at 96.50% and SONAR has a hard cap of 97.5% for any strategy. Max win is 10,000x (SONAR and SONAR 3D: 5,000x) and is always paid. Every round is provably fair: the server seed hash is published before the round and outcomes come from HMAC-SHA256. 1v1 Battles is a separate product line of real-time skill duels (MIRROR and SURGE) where players play against each other and the operator earns a fee per match.

All demos use play money; no real-money gambling is offered on this site. Games are supplied to licensed operators only. Live use needs server-side RNG and certification by an accredited lab (GLI or BMM) in each market. Branded reskins and custom games are built on request; a playable prototype typically takes two to four weeks. Licensing models: catalogue licence, exclusive licence or full IP transfer for custom builds. Contact: nick@caughtgames.com (reply within one business day). Based in the Netherlands.
